_note: v2 hook overrides for la Maison de Couture (B62_couture). Source hooks are kept where the painting shows them; these replace hooks whose painted scene differs (no text or numbers, no weapons).

fr_charme_noun.hook: "SHARM": the boy snake CHARMER plays his flute and the friendly snake sways out of its basket: pure CHARM.
fr_charme_noun.why: A boy plays the flute; the snake sways rather than the sofa.

fr_apparence_noun.hook: "a-pa-RAHNS": before the show, the lady sprinkles sparkles over her gown: APPEARANCE matters.
fr_apparence_noun.why: The painting shows a lady checking her own appearance rather than a parent and son.

fr_virilite_noun.hook: "vee-ree-lee-TAY": the moustached strongman in his tailored suit lifts a dumbbell with one hand: VIRILITY, qualities traditionally thought of as manly.
fr_virilite_noun.why: A painted strongman instead of museum wall text, so no words are painted.

fr_parure_noun.hook: "pa-RÜR": the cat duchess at her mirror tries on a matching PARURE: necklace, earrings and tiara.
fr_parure_noun.why: The duchess is painted as a cat.

fr_admiration_noun.hook: "ad-mee-ra-SYOHN": two white geese stand at the front of the toy stage, gazing up at the show in ADMIRATION.
fr_admiration_noun.why: The painting shows two admiring geese, no swan.

fr_allure_noun.hook: "a-LÜR" (false friend): not "allure" but PACE: the little toy horse trots onto the stage at a steady ALLURE.
fr_allure_noun.why: The horse is a toy figurine on the theatre's edge.

fr_elegance_noun.hook: "ay-lay-GAHNS": the heron walks the red carpet on one LEG with pure ELEGANCE.
fr_elegance_noun.why: The runway is painted as a red carpet.

fr_asperite_noun.hook: "as-pay-ree-TAY": the young model trips over a rough, jagged rock: pure ASPERITY.
fr_asperite_noun.why: A boy in a smart suit trips over the rock.

fr_plaine_noun.hook: "PLEN": behind the toy stage, a painted backdrop of a wide, grassy PLAIN stretches away to one lone tree.
fr_plaine_noun.why: The plain is the painted backdrop behind the figures.

fr_snobisme_noun.hook: "sno-BEESM": SNOBBISHNESS: the clipped poodle turns its nose up at the scruffy mongrel beside it.

fr_exotisme_noun.hook: "eg-zo-TEESM": a straw hat of parrot feathers and tropical flowers: pure EXOTICISM.
fr_exotisme_noun.why: One hat is painted in the cabinet.

fr_scrupule_noun.hook: "skrü-PÜL": the puppy with SCRUPLES brings back the pearl earring it found by the little mirror POOL.
fr_scrupule_noun.why: The pool is the round mirror stand under the puppy.

fr_variete_noun.hook: "va-ryay-TAY": the giraffe eyes every VARIETY of hat on the stand beside it.
fr_variete_noun.why: The hats hang on the stand next to the giraffe.

fr_vecu_noun.hook: "vay-KÜ": Grandpa sits on his big open photo album, laughing "HEY, CUE the next story!": a whole life of LIVED EXPERIENCE.
fr_vecu_noun.why: Grandpa sits on the album rather than flipping it.
